name: UQ Union Kampus Kitchen free dinner
summary: Free dinners for UQ students at St Lucia, Gatton, Herston and Dutton Park.
who: UQ students. St Lucia scans your student ID.
how: St Lucia: Union Complex ground floor from 5pm until meals run out.
Gatton: Wednesdays 4:30 to 5:30pm, Morrison Hall (frozen takeaway meals).
Herston: Thursdays 4:30 to 5:30pm, Oral Health Centre, Level 5 Student Hub.
Dutton Park: Thursdays 3:30 to 5:30pm, Level 5, Susan Tett Building.

evidence.quote: Morning Marmalade & Kampus Kitchen serve up free breakfasts and dinners.
